title: 圣经漫画故事
subtitle: 跟着小昆和小君，一起走进圣经的大故事。

characters.name: 小昆
characters.tagline: 想到什么，就想问个明白。
characters.bio: 好奇心很强，看到没见过的东西，总想凑近一点。想到什么常常就问出来，有时动作比脑袋还快。嘴上开着玩笑，其实也会害怕；遇到不明白的事，他愿意和小君一起找答案。
characters.appearance: 蓬松短发 · 橙色上衣 · 深蓝背包
characters.taglineEn: If something catches his eye, he has to ask about it.
characters.bioEn: Curious and quick to investigate, Xiao Kun always wants a closer look at anything new. He often asks questions as soon as they pop into his head, and sometimes his feet move faster than his thoughts. He jokes around, but he gets scared too—and when he does not understand something, he is willing to look for answers with Xiao Jun.
characters.appearanceEn: Fluffy short hair · orange shirt · navy backpack

characters.name: 小君
characters.bio: 她会先看看周围，注意到别人容易错过的小变化。小昆问得急，她就陪他慢慢找线索。她也有不知道的时候，不会假装自己什么都懂；认真起来很细心，放松时也会吐槽两句。
characters.appearance: 半扎发 · 湖绿色上衣 · 棕色斜挎包
characters.taglineEn: Look first, then find the answer together.
characters.bioEn: Xiao Jun takes a moment to observe and often notices small changes others miss. When Xiao Kun rushes into a question, she helps him slow down and follow the clues. She does not pretend to know everything; she is careful when things get serious and still knows how to tease him when they can relax.
characters.quoteEn: Hang on. Let's take a look.
characters.appearanceEn: Half-up hair · teal shirt · tan crossbody bag

characters.name: 亚当
characters.tagline: 神所造的人，住在伊甸园中。
characters.bio: 他由尘土受造，被安置在伊甸园，承担修理、看守的责任。
characters.taglineEn: The man God formed and placed in the garden of Eden.
characters.bioEn: God formed him from the dust and placed him in the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

characters.name: 夏娃
characters.bio: 她在伊甸园的故事中登场。让我们一起看看，她怎样来到亚当身边。
characters.taglineEn: The companion who corresponds to Adam.
characters.bioEn: She enters the story in the garden of Eden. Let us see how she comes to stand beside Adam.

characters.name: 蛇
characters.tagline: 园子里，另一种声音出现了。
characters.bio: 创世记记载，蛇比田野一切的活物更狡猾。它在园中向女人提出一个问题。
characters.appearance: 橄榄褐色鳞片 · 浅色腹部
characters.taglineEn: Another voice appears in the garden.
characters.bioEn: Genesis says the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field. In the garden, it asks the woman a question.

characters.name: 该隐
characters.tagline: 在园外耕种土地的哥哥。
characters.bio: 他是亚当与夏娃的儿子，也是亚伯的哥哥。他种地，照料地里的出产。
characters.appearance: 成人 · 深棕短发 · 赤陶色衣服
characters.taglineEn: The older brother who works the ground outside the garden.
characters.bioEn: He is the son of Adam and Eve and the older brother of Abel. He cultivates the ground and tends its produce.
characters.appearanceEn: Adult · short dark-brown hair · terracotta clothing

characters.name: 亚伯
characters.bio: 他是该隐的弟弟，在园外牧羊。两兄弟各自生活与劳作，故事从这里继续。
characters.appearance: 成人 · 波浪棕发 · 灰橄榄色衣服
characters.taglineEn: The younger brother who tends the flock.
characters.bioEn: He is Cain’s younger brother and a keeper of sheep outside the garden. The brothers grow up with different work, and their story continues from here.
characters.appearanceEn: Adult · wavy brown hair · gray-olive clothing

characters.name: 拉麦
characters.tagline: 该隐后代中的一家之主。
characters.bio: 他是玛土撒利的儿子，娶了亚大和洗拉。经文从他的家庭继续讲述一代又一代的故事。
characters.appearance: 成人 · 深褐长发与短须 · 暗酒红外衣
characters.taglineEn: A head of household in Cain’s family line.
characters.bioEn: He is the son of Methushael and the husband of Adah and Zillah. Scripture continues the story of the generations through his household.
characters.appearanceEn: Adult · longer dark-brown hair and short beard · dark wine-red clothing

characters.name: 亚大
characters.tagline: 拉麦的妻子，雅八与犹八的母亲。
characters.bio: 她是拉麦的妻子。她的两个儿子雅八和犹八，在帐棚牧养与音乐的故事中登场。
characters.appearance: 成人 · 深棕编发 · 暖赭与米白长衣
characters.taglineEn: Lamech’s wife and the mother of Jabal and Jubal.
characters.bioEn: She is Lamech’s wife. Her sons Jabal and Jubal enter the account of tent living, livestock, and music.
characters.appearanceEn: Adult · dark-brown braid · warm ochre and cream dress

characters.name: 洗拉
characters.tagline: 拉麦的妻子，土八·该隐与拿玛的母亲。
characters.bio: 她是拉麦的妻子，也是土八·该隐和拿玛的母亲。
characters.appearance: 成人 · 深色波浪发 · 蓝灰与沙色长衣
characters.taglineEn: Lamech’s wife and the mother of Tubal-cain and Naamah.
characters.bioEn: She is Lamech’s wife and the mother of Tubal-cain and Naamah.
characters.appearanceEn: Adult · dark wavy hair · blue-gray and sand dress

characters.name: 雅八
characters.tagline: 住帐棚、牧养牲畜之人的祖师。
characters.bio: 他是亚大的儿子，在经文中与住帐棚、牧养牲畜的生活联系在一起。
characters.appearance: 成人 · 沙褐与橄榄色衣服
characters.taglineEn: The ancestor of those who live in tents and raise livestock.
characters.bioEn: He is Adah’s son and is connected in Scripture with tent living and raising livestock.

characters.name: 犹八
characters.bio: 他是雅八的兄弟，经文把弹琴、吹箫的人与他联系起来。
characters.appearance: 成人 · 灰蓝与暖棕衣服 · 古代弦乐器
characters.taglineEn: The ancestor of those who play strings and pipes.
characters.bioEn: He is Jabal’s brother, and Scripture connects him with those who play stringed instruments and pipes.
characters.appearanceEn: Adult · gray-blue and warm-brown clothing · ancient stringed instrument

characters.name: 土八·该隐
characters.tagline: 打造各种铜铁器具的工匠。
characters.bio: 他是洗拉的儿子，在经文中打造各种铜铁器具。
characters.appearance: 成人 · 深灰棕工作衣 · 皮质护前身
characters.taglineEn: A craftsman who forged implements of bronze and iron.
characters.bioEn: He is Zillah’s son and is described as a forger of implements of bronze and iron.
characters.appearanceEn: Adult · dark gray-brown work clothes · leather apron

characters.name: 拿玛
characters.bio: 经文记下她的名字和她与土八·该隐的兄妹关系，没有说明她的职业。
characters.appearance: 成人 · 深棕发 · 梅色与米色长衣
characters.bioEn: Scripture records her name and her relationship to Tubal-cain but does not state her occupation.
characters.appearanceEn: Adult · dark-brown hair · plum and cream dress

characters.name: 塞特
characters.tagline: 亚当与夏娃后来所生的儿子。
characters.bio: 亚伯死后，夏娃生了塞特，并承认这是神另赐的后裔。后来，塞特有了儿子以挪士。
characters.appearance: 成人 · 深棕发 · 柔和土绿衣服
characters.taglineEn: The son later born to Adam and Eve.
characters.bioEn: After Abel’s death, Eve gave birth to Seth and acknowledged him as another offspring given by God. Seth later had a son named Enosh.
characters.appearanceEn: Adult · dark-brown hair · soft earth-green clothing

chapters.title: 创造天地
chapters.summary: 说了好几次的读经约定，今天终于开始了。忘带圣经的小昆和小君来到安静的图书馆，在旧书室发现一本尘封的圣经；从书页浮起的光，带他们走进创造天地的故事。
chapters.introduction: 小昆和小君的穿越是虚构框架；创造的故事依据《创世记》1:1–2:3呈现。
chapters.summaryEn: After putting off their Bible-reading plan again and again, Xiao Kun and Xiao Jun finally begin. They forgot their Bibles, so they search a quiet library, find a dusty copy in an old book room, and follow a strange light from its pages into the story of creation.
chapters.introductionEn: Xiao Kun and Xiao Jun’s journey is a fictional frame; the creation account follows Genesis 1:1–2:3.

chapters.title: 伊甸园
chapters.summary: 小昆和小君把目光转向伊甸园：人从哪里来？丰盛的园子里，又为什么需要一位相配的同伴？
chapters.introduction: 小昆和小君的穿越是虚构框架；伊甸园的故事依据《创世记》2:4–25呈现。
chapters.summaryEn: Xiao Kun and Xiao Jun turn their attention to Eden. Where did the man come from, what was the garden like, and why did he need a companion who corresponded to him?
chapters.introductionEn: Xiao Kun and Xiao Jun’s journey is a fictional frame; the garden of Eden account follows Genesis 2:4–25.

chapters.title: 试探与选择
chapters.summary: 园子里出现了另一种声音。一句看似平常的提问，引出一个选择；小昆和小君继续看着，这两个人的生活会怎样改变？
chapters.introduction: 小昆和小君的穿越是虚构框架；本章依据《创世记》3:1–24呈现。
chapters.summaryEn: Another voice appears in the garden. One ordinary-sounding question leads to a choice, and Xiao Kun and Xiao Jun watch how life changes afterward.
chapters.introductionEn: Xiao Kun and Xiao Jun’s journey is a fictional frame; this chapter follows Genesis 3:1–24.

chapters.title: 园外的两兄弟
chapters.summary: 园外的日子继续，该隐与亚伯长大了。两兄弟献上供物后，一阵怒气带来新的选择；小昆和小君静静看着接下来发生的事。
chapters.introduction: 小昆和小君的穿越是虚构框架；本章依据《创世记》4:1–16呈现。
chapters.summaryEn: Life continues outside the garden, and Cain and Abel grow up. After the brothers bring their offerings, rising anger leads to another choice.
chapters.introductionEn: Xiao Kun and Xiao Jun’s journey is a fictional frame; this chapter follows Genesis 4:1–16.

chapters.title: 一代又一代
chapters.summary: 该隐在挪得之地成家、建城，许多世代随后过去。新的生活与技艺出现了，拉麦却把暴力变成夸口；经文随后转回亚当与夏娃，并以人开始求告耶和华的名收束。
chapters.introduction: 小昆和小君的穿越是虚构框架；本章依据《创世记》4:17–26呈现。
chapters.summaryEn: Cain builds a household and a city in the land of Nod, and generations pass. New ways of life and new skills appear, while Lamech turns violence into a boast. Scripture then returns to Adam and Eve and closes with people beginning to call on the name of the Lord.
chapters.introductionEn: Xiao Kun and Xiao Jun’s journey is a fictional frame; this chapter follows Genesis 4:17–26.

subtitleEn: Join Xiao Kun and Xiao Jun as they step into the great story of the Bible.
